g.text: The residency ladder — what is actually in RAM while streaming a dump
never fully read, never fully decompressed
streaming bzip2 — one block at a time
yielded to the consumer, then dropped
adaptor, so bytes are inflated only as the XML parser
asks for them. Back-pressure therefore reaches all the
way down to the disk — nothing runs ahead.
*document's* sentences into a Vec before flattening
(the borrow of doc.content may not escape the closure).
Peak residency is therefore *one document's* sentences —
far less than the corpus, but more than one sentence.
⇒ shard a large plaintext corpus into many files, or use
